title: Semantic Synthesis over Brute-Force Search: LLM-Guided Transformation Design for Efficient Learning
summary: LLM-generated image transformations performed well in the reported CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100 and SVHN experiments, using fewer candidate evaluations than brute-force search. One-epoch selection scores predicted 20-epoch outcomes in some dataset/architecture pairs but were weak or uninformative in others.
ai_technology: Large language models generating executable image-transformation programs
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: Across image-classification datasets, generated transformations were evaluated with one-epoch selection and retrained for 20 epochs; outcomes varied across dataset/architecture pairs, with proxy-score correlations ranging from 0.756 to near zero.
evidence.unknown: Short-budget selection is not a reliable proxy in every dataset/architecture pair; results are limited to the reported datasets and training setup.
evidence.ai_role: LLMs synthesized transformation code; classifiers evaluated candidate transformations under short and longer training budgets.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
